title: Solana wallet login
summary: Sign in to Oren with a Solana wallet. Add an email to the same account whenever you want.

items.title: Start with your wallet
items.description: Choose Continue with wallet and approve the sign-in request in your Solana wallet. You can create an account without an email.

items.title: Link an email later
items.description: Add an email from Settings when you want email features, including optional notifications.

video.label: Solana wallet sign-in on Oren, a nine-second feature film
video.caption: Continue with a Solana wallet and sign in to Oren. Illustrated sign-in flow.
